profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Marvell Semiconductor
profile.summary:
NOTE: I am NOT looking to change jobs right now.
* Senior Software Engineer with a strong background in embedded computing and computer networking.
* Experience with porting U-Boot.
* Strong MIPS experience.
* Experience adding MIPS support to Valgrind.
* Experienced with Agere and Cavium network processors.
* Experience with routing, bridging, tunneling, MPLS, Ethernet, ATM and more.
* IPSec experience
* Linux and VxWorks device driver experience.
* IPv4 and IPv6 forwarding.
* Experience with TDM and serial traffic.
* Experience working closely with hardware, reading schematics, data sheets and in some cases VHDL.
* Experienced with working closely with hardware engineers to help define the system architecture.
* Troubleshooting both hardware and software problems.
* Implemented an entire router data path with the Agere network processor.
* Almost 10 years of experience working with embedded systems with VxWorks and Linux.
* Strong background with optimization and improving performance while keeping memory usage under control.
* Embedded processor experience with various MIPS and PowerQuicc, especially with the Cavium Octeon series.
* Long experience with both Linux and Solaris (though lately all Linux).
* C, Agere FPL, C++ and PHP, though C++ and PHP experience is limited since most work was with C.
* Very experienced with the Agere FPL programming model with a strong understanding of how it works at a low level.
* Experience porting applications to run in embedded Linux environments including build-root, Cavium and more.
* Experienced with IP Infusion ZebOS.
* Experienced with Cisco IOS data plane model.

My goals are to expand my experience with more IPv6 and to move to other areas of networking.

Specialties: My specialty is in network processors, routing, U-Boot and embedded Linux.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Marvell Semiconductor acquired Cavium on 7/6/2018. I work on U-Boot, ATF, low-level cores, and Linux. I work with many low-level drivers such as eMMC, SPI, I3C, security modules, etc. I also maintain the OcteonTX SDK. I am quite involved in the boot process.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Currently working on U-boot bootloader support for the Octeon multi-core 64-bit MIPS processors. Also involved in MIPS Valgrind development. I am NOT looking to change jobs at this time.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on device drivers for both Ethernet and ATM networking cards.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Wrote software for many aspects of the FlowWise Router Accelerator. Later Acquired by Network Equipment Technologies, Inc.

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description: I spent my summers while in College working for GRiD Systems. I worked on BIOS and various DOS TSR (terminate-stay-resident) applications for various laptops and pen-based computers.
